Det dere skriver inn, lagres bare i nett: What you type is only stored in the browser on this device. We only count anonymously how many people visit and which games are opened – without cookies and without personal data.
What you type is only stored in the browser on this device. We have no server that receives it.
For å vite om rusj blir brukt, teller vi: To know whether rusj is being used, we count anonymously. Your browser sends a few short words from a fixed list, such as ‘a page was opened: Ordugla’, ‘a game was started’ or ‘was here yesterday too’. We only store the total for each day, such as ‘yesterday Ordugla was started 214 times’.
{tittel} hvilke sider og spill som åpnes: {tittel} which pages and games are opened, started and finished; whether the browser visited yesterday, in the last week, longer ago or never before; whether rusj was opened from the home screen; roughly how long a visit lasts (under 1, 1–3, 3–10, 10–30 or over 30 minutes); and how many of the day's puzzles are solved and how many days in a row (in groups).
{tittel} navn, det dere skriver, svar, p: {tittel} names, anything you type, answers, scores, times of day or anything about your device. There is no ID, there are no cookies and there is no way to follow one person from day to day.
{tittel} tallene lagres hos Cloudflare,: {tittel} the numbers are stored with Cloudflare, in a database located in the EU. When your browser sends them, Cloudflare sees your IP address, as every website does, but we don't store it and we have switched the logs off. Numbers older than 25 months are deleted.
{tittel} har du slått på «Ikke spor» ({d: {tittel} if you have switched on {dnt} or {gpc}, or data saving, in your browser, rusj sends nothing.
Personvern – hva rusj lagrer på enheten: Privacy – what rusj stores on your device
rusj har ingen konto, ingen informasjons: rusj has no accounts, no cookies, no tracking and no ads. See exactly what is stored in your browser – and delete it all with one tap.
Kort sagt: rusj har ingen konto, ingen i: In short: rusj has no accounts, no cookies, no tracking and no ads. What you type into the games stays in the browser on your device.
Vi teller bare anonymt hvor mange som br: We only count anonymously how many people use rusj and which games are opened.
Dette lagres i nettleseren din: What is stored in your browser
For at spillene skal virke, bruker rusj: For the games to work, rusj uses the browser's own storage on your device ({ls}). These are not cookies, and none of it is sent to us:
{tittel} dere skriver inn, så dere slipp: {tittel} you type in, so you don't have to type them again in the next game.
{tittel} lyd av eller på, filteret du va: {tittel} sound on or off, the filter you chose on the front page, your answer to ‘18 or over?’ and whether you have seen or closed a tip.
{tittel} runden dere holder på med, så d: {tittel} the round you're playing, so you can pick up where you left off – including what you have written or drawn along the way, your own rules and a Secret Santa draw. Also which cards have been used, records, which of the day's puzzles you have solved, and tonight's scoreboard.
{tittel} hvilken dag du sist var innom o: {tittel} which day you last visited and how long the visit has lasted. That way the browser itself can say ‘was here yesterday’ without us finding out who you are.
{tittel} hvilke klistremerker du har sam: {tittel} which stickers you have collected and on which day, and which games you have tried – so the book knows what's missing.
Alt dette ligger bare i denne nettlesere: All of this stays only in this browser on this device.
Ingenting av det sendes til oss, og vi k: None of it is sent to us, and we can't see it.
Vi har ingen server som tar imot det, og: We have no server that receives it, and we can't see it.
Spillene lastes ned for bruk uten nett: The games are downloaded for offline play
Når du åpner rusj, lagrer nettleseren en: When you open rusj, your browser saves a copy of the page you're on. The rest of the games are downloaded bit by bit while your phone is idle (not on a very slow connection or with data saving on), so they work offline too. The copy is replaced when the games are updated.
rusj.no ligger hos GitHub Pages, en tjen: rusj.no is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service from the American company GitHub. As with every website, the host gets ordinary request logs when a page is fetched: your IP address, the time, which page it was and what kind of browser you use. This is processed outside the EU/EEA. We have no access to these logs and don't use them for anything.
No accounts and no logging in.
Ingen sporing av enkeltpersoner. Vi tell: No tracking of individuals. We only count anonymous daily totals (see ‘Anonymous counting’).
Ingen sporing, statistikk eller måling a: No tracking, statistics or measuring of what you do.
Ingen reklame, og ingenting som hentes f: No ads, and nothing loaded from other websites.
Noen spill lar deg dele en kode, en lenk: Some games let you share a code, a link or a result. It only goes where you send it, in the app you choose. An invitation contains what the recipient needs to join in – in a Secret Santa link, that includes names from the draw.
Knappen fjerner alt rusj har lagret i de: The button removes everything rusj has saved in this browser: names, settings, games in progress, records and the downloaded copy of the games. This can't be undone.
Slett alt rusj har lagret på denne enhet: Delete everything rusj has saved on this device
Du kan også slette nettstedsdata for rus: You can also clear the site data for rusj.no in your browser settings. If you use rusj again afterwards, what is needed is saved again – including the copy of the games for offline play.
Skriver du til oss, bruker vi e-postadre: If you write to us, we only use your email address to reply to you.
